title: POWERHOUSES OF THE CELL
subtitle: They are the central energy source pulsing at the heart of our cellular network.
visual_goal: Establish mitochondria as the central, powerful energy source, pulsing with vital energy at the heart of a cellular network.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: title scale-pop in
0.5s: central icon pulsates with light
1.5s: energy particles emerge and swirl upward
2.8s: network lines subtly connect to core
4.0s: camera slow zoom in

title: ENERGY CONVERSION ENGINE
subtitle: Glucose and oxygen enter the factory to be transformed into ATP.
visual_goal: Illustrate a concise energy factory process, showing glucose and oxygen entering, transforming, and exiting as glowing ATP particles.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: factory icon assembles from lines
0.8s: glucose and oxygen icons drift in from left
1.5s: inputs enter factory, internal glow intensifies
2.5s: glowing ATP particles burst out to the right
3.5s: title and labels fade in

title: RELENTLESS FUEL CYCLE
subtitle: A continuous process ensuring every cell is constantly fueled.
visual_goal: Emphasize the continuous, cyclical nature of energy production through a dynamic, flowing loop.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: energy loop diagram materializes as a glowing circuit
0.7s: input arrows animate, feeding into central core
1.5s: central core pulses brightly with each 'cycle'
2.8s: ATP particles continuously drift along the loop and outward
4.0s: caption fades in with subtle bounce

title: ASTONISHING ENERGY SCALE
subtitle: The body produces a mind-boggling amount of energy molecules every minute.
visual_goal: Visually convey the immense scale of ATP production with a huge, animating number surrounded by a vast constellation of tiny energy units.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: central ATP counter appears with a quick count-up effect
0.8s: thousands of tiny dots representing ATP molecules swirl into frame
2.0s: dots expand outwards, filling the screen like a galaxy
3.0s: central counter glows and pulses softly
4.5s: callout text fades in below the counter
label: ATP molecules produced every minute

title: ANCIENT ORIGINS MERGER
subtitle: Mitochondria were once free-living bacteria, now integral to every complex cell.
visual_goal: Represent the endosymbiotic theory by showing two distinct, ancient cellular forms merging and revealing their shared DNA.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: two distinct blob-like cell shapes drift into frame from opposite sides
1.2s: shapes begin to merge, creating a shimmering effect at the point of contac
2.5s: a glowing double-helix DNA strand emerges within the merged form
3.5s: title and caption appear with a soft reveal
4.5s: the merged form pulsates gently

title: SYSTEM COLLAPSE
subtitle: Mitochondrial failure leads to catastrophic organ and muscle breakdown.
visual_goal: Convey the catastrophic impact of mitochondrial failure through a fracturing, sparking energy core and broken connections.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: a vibrant energy core shatters into pieces
0.8s: red warning lights flash rapidly around the broken core
1.5s: connection lines snap and dissipate into dust
2.5s: energy particles rapidly fade and disappear
3.5s: title and callout slam into place with a subtle shake

title: UNDERSTANDING LIFE ITSELF
subtitle: A complete, vital cellular network glowing with renewed energy and harmony.
visual_goal: Reiterate the fundamental importance of mitochondria by showing a complete, vital cellular network, glowing with renewed energy and harmony.
motion_choreography: 0.0s: fractured elements from previous scene slowly coalesce and mend
1.2s: the cellular network lights up from center outwards
2.5s: energy points within the network begin to pulse in harmony
3.8s: title text emerges from the glowing network
5.0s: camera slowly zooms out to reveal the full, vibrant system

takeaways.text: Mitochondria are the essential powerhouses, converting fuel into energy for all
Your body produces an astonishing 9 × 10^20 ATP molecules every minute.
These vital organelles have a surprising past as ancient, free-living bacteria.
